events.title: Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts
events.blurb: The rebuilt museum in MacArthur Park, with free admission; open late until 8 p.m. on Friday.
events.blurbEs: El museo renovado en MacArthur Park, con entrada gratis; el viernes abre hasta las 8 p.m.
events.getThere: Free on-site parking; served by Little Rock METRO Route 6 at Commerce Street.

events.title: Mojo Brookzz: Outta Pocket Tour
events.addr: 426 W Markham St, Little Rock, AR 72201
events.blurb: Two Black Friday shows from the Chicago comedian and actor; both are sold out.
events.blurbEs: Dos funciones el Black Friday del comediante y actor de Chicago; ambas están agotadas.
events.getThere: Robinson Center shares an underground parking garage with the DoubleTree by Hilton Little Rock.

events.title: A Community Celebration of The Last Waltz: A Film Screening
events.addr: Argenta Arts District, North Little Rock, AR 72114
events.blurb: An evening screening of The Last Waltz, the concert film of The Band's farewell show, with a community celebration in Argenta.
events.blurbEs: Una proyección nocturna de The Last Waltz, el documental del concierto de despedida de The Band, con una celebración comunitaria en Argenta.

events.title: Clinton Presidential Library and Museum
events.addr: 1200 President Clinton Ave, Little Rock, AR 72201
events.blurb: Full-size Oval Office replica and exhibits on the Clinton years, beside the river. Open Fri–Sat 9–5, Sun 1–5.
events.blurbEs: Réplica a tamaño real del Despacho Oval y exposiciones sobre los años de Clinton, junto al río. Abierto vie–sáb 9–5, dom 1–5.

events.title: Big Dam Bridge
events.addr: 7600 Rebsamen Park Rd, Little Rock, AR 72207
events.blurb: Walk or bike across the Arkansas River on one of the country's longest pedestrian bridges, linked to about 15 miles of riverside trails.
events.blurbEs: Camina o pedalea sobre el río Arkansas en uno de los puentes peatonales más largos del país, conectado a unas 15 millas de senderos.
